lints.name: authenticated_security_definer_function_executable
lints.title: Signed-In Users Can Execute SECURITY DEFINER Function
lints.description: Detects `SECURITY DEFINER` functions that are callable by signed-in users. Revoke `EXECUTE`, switch the function to `SECURITY INVOKER`, or move it out of your exposed API schema if signed-in users should not call it.

findings.detail: Function `public.identity_workspace_role(workspace_reference uuid)` can be executed by the `authenticated` role as a `SECURITY DEFINER` function via `/rest/v1/rpc/identity_workspace_role`. Revoke `EXECUTE` or switch it to `SECURITY INVOKER` if that is not intentional.

Function `public.user_can_access_trust_workspace(workspace_reference uuid)` can be executed by the `authenticated` role as a `SECURITY DEFINER` function via `/rest/v1/rpc/user_can_access_trust_workspace`. Revoke `EXECUTE` or switch it to `SECURITY INVOKER` if that is not intentional.

Function `public.user_has_trust_workspace_role(workspace_reference uuid, allowed_roles text[])` can be executed by the `authenticated` role as a `SECURITY DEFINER` function via `/rest/v1/rpc/user_has_trust_workspace_role`. Revoke `EXECUTE` or switch it to `SECURITY INVOKER` if that is not intentional.

lints.description: Leaked password protection is currently disabled.

findings.detail: Supabase Auth prevents the use of compromised passwords by checking against HaveIBeenPwned.org. Enable this feature to enhance security.
